title: OpenMHS per-repo task card
description: MHS/registry/tasks/<track>/<owner>__<repo>.json: one card per corpus repo, the only input a driver author (human or model) gets. Generated by MHS/registry/taskcards.py from the triage decision, the corpus lock and a bounded AST scan; hints are suggestions, never a specification. A card is dispatched only when decision is direct-driver or family-config, helper_status is available, blocked_on is empty, quarantine is false and package_status is none or in_progress (a passing package is not dispatched again).

sourcePath.description: Source evidence only: normalized relative POSIX path; spaces allowed; no traversal or control characters. Package paths are unchanged.

local_path.description: Read-only upstream clone, relative to the corpus root.

driver_dir.description: The only directory the driver author writes.

commit.description: Pinned HEAD of the clone; null only for an empty upstream.

family.description: Integration family (python-object, serial, scpi, gymnasium, mujoco, or a post-pilot family such as ros or qcodes).

helper.description: The Driver helper class the package subclasses; null while the family's helper does not exist.

package_status.description: State of the driver package in driver_dir (MHS/drivers/**, read-only): none (no directory), in_progress (no RESULT.json yet), pass (RESULT.json passed the gate), blocked or skip-proposed (its codes are in blocked_on). The generator always writes it; it is optional so that a package's task.json copied from an earlier card stays valid.

symbol.description: Source-only dotted class or pyfile:path.py#Class / pyfile:path.py#* selector; never a runtime import target.

confidence.description: ast: the class definition is in the clone at file:line; recon: a registration whose class is not defined in the clone or was not found (file:line is the registration); override: named by an entry of MHS/registry/overrides (a recon proposal a maintainer accepted), defined on or just after file:line; guess: not produced by the generator.

models.description: MuJoCo scene and robot models a MujocoDriver can load, ranked; the first is the main model. Only loadable MJCF files with actuators (directly or through files they include) are listed; object and fixture assets, fragments, templates and copies under examples, tests or vendored trees never are. Empty for other cards. The generator always writes it; it is optional so that a package's task.json copied from an earlier card stays valid.

kind.description: scene: a scene-named file or one that includes others; robot: a robot model.

expected_mode.description: The record's first mode (hardware first for dual-mode records); null for a never-dispatched card of a record without modes (not a device).

risk_floor.description: Highest risk_class of the candidate classes in the capability catalogue.

needs_recon.description: What the scan could not derive: decision, entry_symbol, model (a MuJoCo card without a main model), install, capabilities, limit_sources, license, artifacts (the README downloads assets, models or LFS objects the clone does not hold) motion (a robot hardware card whose motion API was not found) and mode (a recon card of a simulation repo whose code also drives hardware: the recon decides which mode the driver serves).

publish_review.description: required when the upstream licence class is network-copyleft, source-available, proprietary or unknown: the user decides before a driver for it is published (drivers import, never vendor, upstream code).

companions.description: Reviewed companion sources (user decision 2026-11-05), copied from a registry override with the corpus lock's local_path and repo_url and the companion record's licence: corpus repositories cloned locally at their corpus-lock commit that this package's e-stop, its read-back (safety_bindings.safe_state), its declared re-enable and its facts may cite as companion:<alias>/<path>:<LINE>. An entry with lock is a clone fetched under work/companions (its LOCK.json path, repo_url, ref and licence; licence_note when that licence is not an SPDX expression). Absent on every other card. Gate G1 checks each clone, its HEAD, a fetched clone's LOCK.json entry, untracked files and write bits, and the version evidence; G2 the lock's copy; G4 and G7 the citations and their scope. hardware_stop true (user decision 4, 2026-11-05) is the one exception: a hardware package the user named may cite that lock companion from its stop and its fresh read-back. Its profile is not a ROS profile, and its ref is the full commit. The hardware backend still needs a human reviewed_by with scope hardware.

profile.description: A ROS generation-distro-simulator release (ros1-noetic-gazebo11), or, when hardware_stop is true, a non-ROS profile such as micromanager-2.0-gamma-20230120.

hardware_stop.description: User decision 4 of 2026-11-05: this lock companion may be cited by this hardware package's stop and its fresh read-back. The hardware backend still needs a human reviewed_by with scope hardware.

lock.description: The work/companions/LOCK.json alias of a fetched companion clone (absent for a corpus companion).

ref.description: The tag or branch the fetched clone was taken at (LOCK.json ref).

licence_note.description: The LOCK.json licence text of a fetched companion when it is not an SPDX expression (license_spdx is then NOASSERTION).
